_comment: Example Claude Code hook wiring for this workspace. Copy to .claude/settings.json at the repo root, then restart Claude Code (or run /hooks) to approve the hooks. $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR resolves to the repo root. For any OTHER harness, map these four lifecycle points (session start / pre-Bash / post-Bash / session stop) to your harness's equivalent, and export AGENT_PROJECT_DIR=<repo root> so git-sync.sh finds the repo. The git-sync hooks no-op until you add a git remote (see onboarding.md).
